fixes.explanation: That's a fair guess, since Micah had heard her utter a curse about the silver. But what she says is, "Blessed be my son by the LORD!" (Judges 17:2) A curse about the silver, and then a blessing for her son. I'd be checking my own ears twice, friend.

No brothers in this verse, friend. Micah "…ordained one of his sons as his priest." (Judges 17:5) When Micah needed a priest, he looked to his own boys. I think the brothers are still waiting by the phone for that call.
